task_decisions.decision: Roaches select a target enemy and navigate to attack it

agent_groups.role_basis: Overseer is an air unit with unrestricted vision across the dividing pit; task description states it must communicate enemy locations. Observation indices 4-35 contain enemy features.
Roaches are ground units blocked by the pit; their enemy_available flags are expected to be zero, making enemy features locally unavailable.

information_requirements.fact: Positions, health, and type of up to four Reaper enemies.
information_requirements.receiver_need_hypothesis: Roaches cannot see enemies due to the pit blocking movement and vision. They need enemy positions and health to select a target, navigate towards it, and engage in combat.
uncertainties: Enemy positions are relative to Overseer; Roaches must transform coordinates using their own position and communicated Overseer location.
Communication delay may cause stale location data if enemies or Overseer move.
Simultaneous targeting of the same enemy by multiple Roaches could lead to overkill if not coordinated, but coordination requires additional information (ally intent) not handled by this requirement.
Bandwidth limits may force omission of some enemy details, requiring selective or sequential communication.
